text: Skip to main content Topic no. 103, Tax help for small businesses and the self-employed English Español 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt More In Help Interactive Tax Assistant Tools Report fraud Tax scams Identity theft Notices and letters Appeals Frequently asked questions Accessibility Contact your local IRS office Contact an international IRS office Tax topics Other languages Please visit the Small business and self-employed tax center page. Our website provides extensive tax information, online tools, and resources especially for persons operating a small business. We offer an array of educational products that you can view or order online at your convenience, night or day. Additionally, our site features an online classroom with video streaming of several of our multimedia educational products; see Small business online learning . We also include an ever-expanding list of services, such as the online application for an employer identification number (EIN), E-file: Do your taxes for free , E-file for business and self-employed taxpayers and the Gig economy tax center page.
